skies.name: Photo studio
skies.why: Large softboxes on a white infinity cyc. The reference light for a product shot, and the one that flatters a detail model.

skies.name: Partly cloudy
skies.why: A bright sky with soft-edged cloud. Shadows with an edge you can see but not a hard one - the condition most of a temperate year is.

skies.name: Clear sun
skies.why: A clear sky with the sun high. Hard shadows and a strong sky-blue fill in them, which is what makes a white wall read as two colours.

skies.name: Low sun
skies.why: A low warm sun over water. Long shadows and a raking light down a facade, which is the condition an elevation is usually drawn for.
